title: Cumulative Layout Shift percentiles
sqlTemplate: select approx_percentile_cont(view_cumulative_layout_shift, 0.5) as p50, approx_percentile_cont(view_cumulative_layout_shift, 0.75) as p75, approx_percentile_cont(view_cumulative_layout_shift, 0.95) as p95, count(*) filter (where view_cumulative_layout_shift is not null) as sample_count from _rumdata where service = {{service}} and env = {{environment}}{{version_clause}} and type = 'view'
emptyDataSemantics: sample_count = 0 -> p50/p75/p95 are SQL NULL -> NO_DATA, never rendered as 0.
